description: A Premier League club's next match in any competition (Premier League, FA Cup, Carabao Cup, Champions League, Europa League, Conference League): opponent, competition, kick-off in UTC and UK time (plus a local time if you give a time zone), ground and the confirmed UK TV channel. If the club is playing right now it returns that game. Use this for "when do Arsenal play next?" or "who are Liverpool playing next?".

club.description: A Premier League club, as people write it: "Arsenal", "Spurs", "Man Utd", "Brighton", "Forest".

timezone.description: Optional IANA time zone for an extra local kick-off time, e.g. "America/New_York". UK time is always included.

name: next_match
title: Next match
